comments.author: Gudebuddha
comments.body:
I used this map Observation Record of Saturn to grind the thesis. From Amsterdam Archive, R7 Recognition/Astronomy in Gulf of Guinea. Reported the discovery in Saint-Georges at Nzinga Nkuwa, not an astro disc NPC, so i didn't got the full reward, but it was fast, took me overall 74 minutes for the needed 32 maps.

Only req for the map is this Quest: A Planet with Ears
